sources.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
sources.supports: Frozen base with BA correction, random Gaussian A and zero B, alpha/r scaling. Our gradient formulas are direct differentiation of this parameterization.
sources.not_established: No proof of equal function learning rates for different ViT block placements.

sources.title: The Impact of Initialization on LoRA Finetuning Dynamics
sources.supports: Initial BA equality does not guarantee matching dynamics; initialization, features and stable-learning scales are coupled.
sources.not_established: Large-width simplified analysis and language-model evidence do not prove this finite ViT positional mechanism.
